data.content: The scheduler itself starts `min(limit, items.length)` workers correctly. The flake is in the probe: it records `+` only after the child has consumed stdin, so slow CI process startup can let one 100 ms probe finish before the second records its start. I’ll make the probe record entry immediately on process launch and use a longer overlap window, leaving production code unchanged.
